# `aitbc ai service list`

List available AI services registered with the coordinator.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc ai service list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc ai service list
```
